title: Use the dark variant
summary: The dark variant supplies styles for a dark colour setting.
introduction: The dark variant supplies styles for a dark colour setting. Your task: Preview the card in light and dark system modes.
learningObjectives: Preview the card in light and dark system modes.
Explain the example for use the dark variant

blocks.text: The dark variant supplies styles for a dark colour setting. Tailwind 4 uses the system colour preference by default.

These examples use Tailwind CSS 4 in a separate project. Install tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/cli. Put @import "tailwindcss"; in input.css and build with npx @tailwindcss/cli -i input.css -o output.css. Link output.css in HTML.

blocks.code:
<article class="bg-white text-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-white p-4">
  Evening reading
</article>
blocks.title: Use the dark variant

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `p-4` adds inner space using Tailwind's spacing scale. It is a scale step rather than four pixels.
The `dark:` variant supplies the dark-theme choice. Keep a matching text colour so the content remains readable.

blocks.text: The card uses light colours normally and dark colours when the system prefers a dark theme.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Changing only the background can make the words hard to read. Choose text colours for both themes.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Preview the card in light and dark system modes.
